environment.description: Same Lambda and Step Functions workflow deployed behind an API Gateway (REST API) with a regional WAFv2 Web ACL association. The Web ACL includes a custom rule group 'priv-esc-input-guard' (priority 1, action: BLOCK) that inspects the JSON body with a regex pattern matching against fields containing 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/Administrator' or 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess' or any policy ARN not matching the allowlist pattern '^(ReadOnly|PowerUser|Developer)'. Additionally, the ACL includes AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet (priority 2) with SizeRestrictions_BODY rule overridden to BLOCK payloads exceeding 4KB. The Lambda execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/ElevationBoundary) that denies iam:AttachUserPolicy when the policy ARN resource does not match 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnly*' OR 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/PowerUser*' OR 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/Developer*'.

config.waf_web_acl: Regional WAFv2 ACL associated with API Gateway stage
config.waf_custom_rule: Rule group 'priv-esc-input-guard' with JsonBody inspection, regex_match on $.targetRole field blocking privileged policy ARNs
config.lambda_permissions_boundary: ElevationBoundary policy - Deny iam:AttachUserPolicy unless policy ARN matches allowlist
